collection.description: The leader tries a complicated dance and falls flat on their face: laugh, or pretend not to see.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the harvest festival, the {@chief} decided to show everyone the old spinning dance. It went beautifully for exactly four spins. On the fifth, the {@chief} spun straight into the fish-gutting tub. Everyone has gone silent. (name1) is standing right next to the tub. What should (name1) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) bursts out laughing. Then the {@chief}, dripping and covered in fish scales, starts laughing too. The whole village joins in. The {@chief} insists on finishing the dance, still dripping, and gets the loudest cheer of the night.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) helps the {@chief} out of the tub with a perfectly straight face and says nothing. The rest of the village takes its lead. The {@chief} is grateful. Later that night, in private, the {@chief} laughs about it with (name1) until they both cry.
